summary: Frontend-only validation of Régime A features: (1) Hub 2 parcours, (2) Gantt view Parcours A with 19 rows, weekly header, today line, editable bars with incontournable (red) style + persistence across reload, (3) Kanban Parcours B with 3 OQLF letter templates + proof guide. All acceptance criteria met. One real bug found: the 'Copier' button (kanban-letter-copy) throws an unhandled clipboard permission error in the preview iframe (NotAllowedError: Failed to execute 'writeText' on 'Clipboard': Write permission denied), which triggers the CRA runtime error overlay and blocks the editor UI until dismissed.

ui_bugs.issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText() Promise rejection is not caught -> Uncaught (in promise) NotAllowedError shows CRA runtime error overlay and hides the whole editor. Occurs whenever clipboard permission is denied (preview iframe, HTTP contexts, some browsers).

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/components/KanbanBoard.jsx (LettersProofs.copy), wrap the clipboard call and provide a fallback. Suggested fix: `const copy = async () => { try { if (navigator.clipboard?.writeText) { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(body); } else { throw new Error('no api'); } toast.success('Lettre copiée'); } catch { try { const ta=document.createElement('textarea'); ta.value=body; document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select(); document.execCommand('copy'); document.body.removeChild(ta); toast.success('Lettre copiée'); } catch { toast.error('Copie indisponible — sélectionnez le texte manuellement'); } } };`
critical_code_review_comments: KanbanBoard.copy: unhandled promise rejection from Clipboard API — must be awaited/try-catch.
GanttParcoursA.jsx BarEditor.save: catch block swallows error details (only shows generic toast). Consider logging or displaying validation message.

rca of the issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText() returns a Promise that rejects with NotAllowedError when the document is not allowed clipboard-write permission (common in cross-origin preview iframes). The copy handler (`const copy = () => { navigator.clipboard.writeText(body); toast.success(...); }`) neither awaits nor catches, so React logs an uncaught rejection and the dev overlay hides the editor. Mitigation: await + try/catch with document.execCommand('copy') fallback.
